lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to design a fair level with a path, treasure and a goal, then solve it with as few blocks as you can.
Game designers plan levels: where the walls, treasure and goal go.
A good level is not too easy and not impossible.
Use numbers and repeats to solve levels with fewer blocks.
Easy level: reach the star with 2 blocks.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
